name: ecom Tab-Ex 05 DZ2
summary: The ecom Tab-Ex 05 DZ2 is an intrinsically safe (Ex ic) 8-inch Android tablet from ecom (Pepperl+Fuchs), certified for Zone 2/22 under ATEX and IECEx. It runs Android 16.

atex.marking: II 3G Ex ic IIC T5 Gc / II 3D Ex ic IIIC T85°C Dc
atex.status: IECEx Current, issue 0, checked 2026-10-25. ATEX is a voluntary Certificate of Conformity (Bureau Veritas), not a notified-body EU-type examination (not required for category 3).

iecex.marking: Ex ic IIC T5 Gc / Ex ic IIIC T85°C Dc

certification.northAmerica: SGS certificate SGSNA/25/SUW/00031X (ecom file CERT-B178A, effective 2025-05-24; covers DZ2 and D2): Class I and II, Division 2, Class III, Division 1 & 2, Groups A-D, F and G, T5; Zone 2 Group IIC T5; Zone 22 Group IIIB T100°C; −20 °C ≤ Ta ≤ 50 °C. Under NEC/CEC the limits are Ta +50 °C and dust group IIIB, not +55 °C / IIIC as under ATEX/IECEx. Charging under the SGS certificate only at −5 °C to +45 °C (ATEX/IECEx: −5 °C to +55 °C).

safety.conditions: IECEx X conditions: use where the risk of mechanical hazards is low; not near processes generating high electrostatic charges; the Ex-protective case must be correctly fitted before entering hazardous areas; battery pack and SIM/SD replacement only in ordinary areas; wired connections via USB-C or POGO pins only in ordinary areas; charge only at −5 °C to +55 °C, only from non-shock-hazard supplies (SELV/PELV/ES1) with Um 16 V max, 3.2 A max; repairs by manufacturer or authorised centre. Audio port has intrinsic-safety entity parameters (Uo 3 V, Io 250 mA).
safety.peripherals: No wired connections in the Ex area (USB-C, POGO keyboard port). The 3.5 mm audio port may be used with intrinsically safe audio equipment matching its entity parameters (e.g. ecom HS-Ex 01 J).
safety.certifiedAccessories: Named in the certificate: S Pen ST T05 X2, leather case LC T05 X2, chest harness CH T05 X2, hand strap HA T05 X2R, belt clip BC T01, carrying strap CS T05, stylus tether ST 01. The HS-Ex 01 J in-ear headset has its own IECEx certificate (EPS 25.0070X, Current) for the audio port. Lite Cradle, DC T01 X2 desktop charger, passive holder, screen protector and microSD card are not named in the certificate; chargers and cradles are for use outside the hazardous area only.

os.name: Android
os.edition: Android (Samsung One UI); Android Enterprise Recommended, Samsung Knox 3.10

specs.display: 8-inch TFT, capacitive multitouch, 60 Hz / adaptive up to 120 Hz; Corning Gorilla Glass 3 (DZ1/DZ2), Gorilla Glass 5 (D2)
specs.outdoor: Maker claims optimum readability in direct sunlight (600 nits max)
specs.chip: Samsung Exynos 1380 (S5E8835) octa-core, 4 x 2.4 GHz + 4 x 2.0 GHz, 5 nm
specs.camera: 13 MP autofocus, 8x digital zoom (camera-free version available)
specs.ports: USB 2.0 Type-C; 3.5 mm audio jack and POGO pins on DZ2; microSD; nano-SIM / eSIM
specs.docking: DZ2: Lite Cradle, DC T01 X2 desktop charger, passive holder with tilt/swivel (ordinary areas)
specs.network: 5G Sub-6 and 4G LTE; Wi-Fi-only version also available
specs.keys: Function key (programmable: PTT, emergency call, alarm) and Active button
specs.biometrics: Face recognition; fingerprint only on the D2 model
specs.touch: Yes: glove touch and wet-hands operation (maker)
specs.pen: Samsung S Pen included (pressure sensitive), with Tab-Ex S Pen holder
specs.keyboard: No keyboard; wireless DeX with Bluetooth keyboard/mouse; POGO keyboard-dock port on DZ2 (ordinary areas only)
specs.partNumbers: TAB-EX05-DZ2-* (datasheet t221646; WiFi and WWAN types)

capabilities.label: Push-to-talk
capabilities.value: Via app (programmable function key assignable to PTT, per ecom)

capabilities.label: Emergency / SOS
capabilities.value: Built in (freely programmable function key, e.g. emergency call or alarm)

capabilities.label: Lone worker
capabilities.value: Via app (key assigned to alarm/emergency; third-party or ecom lone-worker solution)

capabilities.label: Barcode scanning
capabilities.value: Via accessory (ecom Ident-Ex 02 wireless 1D/2D scanner; Ex-rated? yes) or camera-based via app

capabilities.label: Remote expert / video calls
capabilities.value: Via app (front and rear cameras, Google ARCore ready; ecom promotes remote-support use)

capabilities.label: Windows desktop software
capabilities.value: Not possible (Android; Samsung DeX gives a desktop-style Android UI)

variants.name: Tab-Ex 05 D2
variants.description: North American version, certified for Class I Division 2 only, with no ATEX or IECEx rating.

unconfirmed.specs.weightG: From a single source; the maker's figures vary.

Also certified for Class I Division 2 in North America

limitations: Zone 2 only, so not for Zone 1 areas
